items.title_zh: 北京现代艾尼氪 V 发布：为中国用户量身定制，预售价 11.99 万元起
items.title_en: Beijing Hyundai IONIQ V Launched: Pre-sale from 119,900 Yuan, Tailored for Chinese Users
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，今天（8 月 21 日）召开的 2026 成都车展上， 北京现代宣布推出旗下艾尼氪 V，预售起价为 11.99 万元。 IT之家附上艾尼氪 V 相关售价信息如下： 标准版 540 Max：预售价 11.99 万元，CTLC 纯电续航 540 公里 高端智驾版本 540 Max+：预售价 12.99 万元，CTLC 纯电续航 540 公里 长续航 650 Max+：预售价 13.99 万元，CTLC 纯电续航 650 公里 艾尼氪 V 设计均由现代中国设计中心全程主导，为中国用户量身定制，并反向输出全球。车辆提供赛博金、次元紫、伽马绿、磁力灰、光子白（素色漆）、光子白（哑光漆）、流光银、夜刃黑等 8 款颜色。 整体采用极其前卫的轿跑溜背式造型，车身比例呈现低重心、宽体化的视觉效果。其车侧采用无框式车门，车尾为次元星轨尾灯样式。 座舱方面，新车车内配备星云环抱式内饰设计，27 英寸超薄 4K 超大屏，星云光影氛围灯，赛博之眼 HUD。车辆深度融合 Momenta、高通 8295 芯片、宁德时代、文心大模型、火山引擎。 规格方面，这款车型长宽高分别为 4900/1890/1470mm，轴距为 2900mm，基于 E-GMP 纯电平台打造，支持纯电 / 增程双动力，具备 800V 快充。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Chengdu Auto Show, Beijing Hyundai unveiled the IONIQ V with a pre-sale price starting at RMB 119,900. The model, designed for Chinese users, comes in three trims with CLTC ranges up to 650 km. It features a 27-inch 4K display, integrates Momenta, Qualcomm 8295, CATL, ERNIE and Volcengine, and is built on E-GMP with 800V fast charging.
items.why_zh: 艾尼氪 V 是北京现代以中国设计主导并反向输出全球的车型，体现了合资品牌对中国市场的深度本土化策略。
items.why_en: The IONIQ V represents Beijing Hyundai's first China-led design with global output, highlighting its deep localization strategy.

items.title_zh: 循环语言模型改进组合工具调用
items.title_en: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling
items.summary_zh: 该研究探讨循环语言模型在智能体工具调用中的潜力。循环语言模型此前在推理任务上表现良好，但在智能体工具使用场景中尚未得到充分探索。研究聚焦于组合工具调用，即模型需要协调多个API调用、维护中间状态并保持工具交互间的依赖关系。作者在API-Bank、BFCL和NESTful三个基准上评估了原生与改造后的循环模型，并在匹配的监督微调设置下与非循环模型对比，同时改变递归深度。该研究旨在验证循环架构能否提升工具调用的组合能力，为智能体系统提供更好的基础模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18171v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Looped language models have shown promising results on reasoning benchmarks, yet their potential for agentic tool use remains largely unexplored. We study this question in compositional tool-calling settings, where models must coordinate multiple API calls, maintain intermediate state, and preserve dependencies across tool interactions. We evaluate native and retrofitted looped language models on API-Bank, BFCL, and NESTful, comparing looped and non-looped models trained under matched supervised fine-tuning recipes and varying recurrent depth at…
items.why_zh: 循环语言模型若在工具调用上有效，将为智能体提供更高效的架构，推动自主任务执行能力发展。
items.why_en: If looped language models prove effective for tool calling, they could offer a more efficient architecture for agentic AI systems, advancing autonomous task execution.

items.title_zh: 边缘内存带宽瓶颈下的 MoE 路由局部性训练：预注册负结果与系统测量
items.title_en: Cacheable by Design? Training Mixture-of-Experts Routers for Locality Against the Edge Memory-Bandwidth Wall: A Pre-Registered Negative Result with a Systems Measurement Study
items.summary_zh: 该研究考察了在单块8GB GPU上运行235B参数MoE模型的内存带宽瓶颈。以Qwen3-235B（Q4_K_M量化，134GB）为例，实测热解码速度仅为0.44 token/s，与按字节/令牌的带宽模型预测一致；而一种本应摊销单次磁盘扫描的批处理方案，在批大小达到32时因分页抖动而失效。论文以预注册负结果的形式，报道了这一系统测量研究，并探讨通过训练路由器增强局部性以缓解带宽压力是否可行。研究发现凸显了在边缘硬件上部署大规模MoE模型的严峻挑战。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18261v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Serving a 235B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model on a single 8 GB GPU is bottlenecked not by compute but by memory bandwidth: decode must stream each token's active experts from whichever tier holds them, and on consumer hardware most experts sit on an SSD far slower than RAM. We quantify this bandwidth wall on Qwen3-235B (Q4_K_M, 134 GB): measured decode is 0.44 tok/s warm, matching a bytes-per-token / bandwidth model, while a batching scheme that should amortize one disk sweep instead collapses at batch 32 from paging thrash. We build ll…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了边缘设备上运行大规模 MoE 模型的性能极限，对低成本本地化部署大模型具有重要参考价值。
items.why_en: This study exposes the practical limits of running large MoE models on edge hardware, with critical implications for cost-effective local deployment.

items.title_zh: FinRCA-Bench：面向金融 AI 系统的证据检索与推理基准
items.title_en: FinRCA-Bench: Benchmarking Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning for Financial AI Systems
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于金融业务，但其推理表现可能取决于是否获得正确的证据。在金融对账中，所需证据分散在发票、采购订单、审批、拨款、支付、分类账和银行活动中，它们通过交易关系而非文本相似性关联，因此端到端准确率可能混淆证据获取与推理质量。为厘清这一问题，研究者提出FinRCA-Bench，一个确定性基准，用于系统评估金融AI系统的证据检索与推理能力。该基准有助于更准确地衡量模型在金融任务中的实际可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18534v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to support financial operations, but their apparent reasoning performance can depend on whether they receive the right evidence. In financial reconciliation, the evidence needed for diagnosis is distributed across invoices, purchase orders, approvals, allocations, payments, ledger entries, and bank activity, linked by transactional relationships rather than textual similarity. End-to-end accuracy can therefore conflate evidence access with reasoning quality. We introduce FinRCA-Bench, a deterministic sy…
items.why_zh: 该基准为金融 AI 提供了更严谨的评估方法，有助于确保大模型在对账等关键任务中的可信应用。
items.why_en: This benchmark provides a more rigorous evaluation method for financial AI, supporting trustworthy LLM deployment in critical tasks like reconciliation.

items.title_zh: AI 后训练还缺什么？一项实证分析
items.title_en: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
items.summary_zh: 该研究探讨了AI智能体自动后训练大型语言模型的现状。LLM智能体现可端到端地训练另一个LLM，包括编写代码、启动训练、评估检查点并改进下游性能，这引发了“AI为AI”的展望。但研究者认为，这一图景混淆了两种不同能力：执行级能力（在选定训练策略内迭代）和策略级能力（随实验证据积累修订高层判断）。通过对大量公开的后训练轨迹进行实证分析，研究者考察了这些能力在不同任务中的表现差异，以厘清自动化训练所缺失的关键环节。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now post-train an LLM end-to-end. They can write code, launch training, evaluate checkpoints, and improve downstream performance, raising the prospect of AI-for-AI. We argue that this picture conflates two distinct capabilities: execution-level capability, iterating within a selected training strategy; and strategy-level capability, revising the high-level judgment as experimental evidence accumulates. Analyzing a large corpus of publicly released post-training trajectories, we find that across different task…
items.why_zh: 该研究有助于区分AI自动化训练中的执行能力与策略能力，为评估AI自我改进的真实进展提供依据。
items.why_en: This research clarifies the distinction between execution and strategy capabilities in automated AI training, aiding in assessing the true progress of AI self-improvement.

items.title_zh: 视觉提示引导的野生动物个体级识别
items.title_en: Visual-Prompt Guided Wildlife Instance-Level Recognition
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出了一种单阶段端到端的野生动物检测与再识别模型，用于细粒度个体识别。与当前主流的两阶段检测-再识别流水线不同，新方法直接在潜在空间中进行身份搜索，避免了分离模块带来的误差累积。模型采用DINOv2提取鲁棒的空间几何特征，并使用MegaDescriptor完成野生动物再识别，同时通过提示再识别特征增强潜在查询。检测解码器查询场景潜在空间以确定物体边界，从而在统一框架内实现检测与身份识别。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18246v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fine-grained wildlife re-identification remains a challenging area in research. Current state-of-the-art approaches apply a detection and re-identification pipeline. We propose a one-stage end-to-end detection and re-identification model that performs identity searching within the latent space. We adopt DINOv2 for robust spatial geometry and MegaDescriptor for wildlife re-identification. We enhance latent queries with prompt re-identification features. A detection decoder queries the scene latent space to establish object boundaries around the…
items.why_zh: 该研究有望简化野生动物识别流程，提高个体级监测的效率，为生态保护提供更便捷的技术手段。
items.why_en: This work could streamline wildlife recognition pipelines, improving efficiency of instance-level monitoring for conservation efforts.

items.title_zh: SIDScope：生成式推荐中语义 ID 接口的诊断资源
items.title_en: SIDScope: A Diagnostic Resource for Semantic-ID Interfaces in Generative Recommendation
items.summary_zh: 语义ID映射是项目分词器与生成式推荐器之间的可复用接口，但现有映射很少说明其一致性、结构、路径解析及刷新后的重验证需求。为解决这一问题，研究者提出SIDScope，一个带有来源追踪的诊断资源。该工具可标准化项目到代码的产物，验证来源与连接，分析映射结构，比较配对修订版本，并解释生成痕迹中的路径到项目结果。研究在九个来源追踪的分词器上应用了SIDScope，为生成式推荐中语义ID接口的选择与维护提供了系统化支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18779v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Semantic-ID mappings are reusable interfaces between item tokenizers and generative recommenders, yet released mappings rarely state whether they are coherent, what structure they expose, how generated paths resolve, or what must be revalidated after a refresh. SIDScope is a source-traced diagnostic resource for these decisions. It normalizes item-to-code artifacts, verifies provenance and joins, profiles mapping structure, compares paired revisions, and accounts for path-to-item outcomes in generated traces. Across nine source-traced tokenizer…
items.why_zh: 该工具为生成式推荐中的语义 ID 接口提供了系统化诊断手段，有助于提升接口的可靠性与可维护性。
items.why_en: This resource provides systematic diagnostics for semantic-ID interfaces in generative recommendation, improving their reliability and maintainability.

items.title_zh: SkillForge：面向项目特定问题解决的自蒸馏智能体
items.title_en: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution
items.summary_zh: 基于LLM的智能体在自动化软件问题解决上表现出色，但常因缺乏项目特定知识而在特定仓库的问题上受挫。现有自进化方法从仓库历史或在线修复轨迹中获取知识，但要么依赖已有的历史问题解决信号，要么产生高昂的按问题测试时探索成本。为此，研究者提出SkillForge，一种自蒸馏框架，让智能体在解决问题过程中提炼并复用技能，从而更高效地获取项目特定知识。该研究旨在减少对历史信号和在线探索的依赖，提升自动化修复在真实项目中的实用性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18933v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) based agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in automated software issue resolution, yet they often struggle to resolve issues in a specific repository because they lack project-specific knowledge. Existing self-evolving approaches acquire such knowledge from repository history or online repair trajectories, but they either depend on available historical issue-resolution signals or incur substantial per-issue test-time exploration cost. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a self-distillation framework that…
items.why_zh: SkillForge 提出了一种更高效的项目知识获取方式，有望提升自动化修复在真实仓库中的表现。
items.why_en: SkillForge offers a more efficient way to acquire project-specific knowledge for automated issue resolution, potentially improving real-world performance.

items.title_zh: 通过人声模仿查询音效的微调策略
items.title_en: Finetuning Strategies for Querying Sounds by Vocal Imitation
items.summary_zh: 该技术报告介绍了作者在 AES AIMLA 2025 挑战赛中的获奖方案，该任务要求通过人声模仿来查询音效。作者研究了两种互补的微调策略：一种是在冻结的预训练 CED 编码器上应用对比学习；另一种是使用 MobileNetV3 编码器，联合对比学习和三元组学习，并引入半硬负样本。报告在赛后进行了更新，补充了挑战结束后披露的细节。这项工作为人声模仿音效检索提供了有效的微调思路，有望推动音频检索交互方式的发展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19174v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This technical report describes our winning submission to the AES AIMLA 2025 Challenge on querying sound effects by vocal imitation. We investigate two complementary fine-tuning strategies: contrastive learning with a frozen, pretrained CED encoder, and joint contrastive-triplet learning with semi-hard negatives using a MobileNetV3 encoder. This report has been updated for posterity to include details released after the challenge.
items.why_zh: 为基于人声模仿的音效检索提供了经过竞赛验证的微调策略，具有实际应用价值。
items.why_en: Provides validated fine-tuning strategies for vocal-imitation sound search, with real-world applicability.

items.title_zh: 训练模型而非读者：可验证激活解释的可解码性监督
items.title_en: Train the Model, Not the Reader: Decodability Supervision for Verifiable Activation Explanations
items.summary_zh: 该研究指出，自然语言自编码器通过重建隐藏激活来评估解释的忠实度：只要解释能重建激活，就被视为忠实。但这种测试对单个错误声明不敏感——如果翻转某个声明而重建结果不变，该声明不会受到任何惩罚。作者展示了重建测试可以通过两种方式通过，而两种方式都不忠实。在已发布的 Qwen-2.5-7B verbalizer 上，解释的重建效果远高于随机水平，但重建实际依赖的具体声明仅约 2%，说明大部分声明可能是错误的。这一发现提醒研究者，现有的重建式可解释性评估方法存在结构性缺陷。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.20379v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Natural-language autoencoders score explanations of hidden activations by reconstruction. An explanation is deemed faithful if the activation can be regenerated from it. The test is structurally insensitive to individual false claims. If flipping a claim does not change the reconstruction, the claim is never penalized. We show the test is passed in two ways, neither faithful. On a released Qwen-2.5-7B verbalizer, explanations reconstruct well above chance while ~2% of specific claims are ones the reconstruction depends on, so the score tracks…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了解释性评估中重建分数可能掩盖大量错误声明，对可解释 AI 的可信度构成挑战。
items.why_en: It uncovers a structural flaw in reconstruction-based faithfulness metrics, undermining the reliability of activation explanations.

items.title_zh: DeltaML-Bench：在真实世界研究仓库中评估机器学习智能体
items.title_en: DeltaML-Bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Real-World Research Repositories
items.summary_zh: 自主机器学习实验智能体需要在不完美的开源代码库中导航、修复训练管道，并在现实计算约束下评估候选改进，但现有基准难以完全模拟这些条件。为此，作者推出 DeltaML-Bench，一个包含 48 个源自研究论文任务的基准，要求智能体在存在缺陷的开源仓库中改进已发表的基线。作者使用标准 Modular agent 和基于搜索的 ARG 脚手架，对 GPT-5 和 Claude Sonnet 4 进行了评估。该基准更真实地反映了机器学习研究中的工程挑战，为衡量自主智能体的实际能力提供了更可靠的测试平台。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19653v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous agents for machine learning experimentation must navigate heterogeneous repositories, repair training pipelines, and evaluate candidate improvements under realistic compute constraints. Existing benchmarks only partially capture these conditions. We introduce DeltaML-Bench, a benchmark comprising 48 tasks sourced from research papers that require agents to improve published baselines within imperfect, open-source repositories. We evaluate GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4 with a standard Modular agent and a search-based ARG scaffolding. In the…
items.why_zh: 它面向真实研究代码库的复杂性，为评估自主 ML 智能体提供了更贴近实际的新基准。
items.why_en: It offers a realistic benchmark for autonomous ML agents by tackling imperfect real-world research repositories.

items.title_zh: 城市环境下神经制图晕渲的评估：基于高分辨率 DEM/DSM 的卡尔加里市中心研究
items.title_en: Evaluating Neural Cartographic Relief Shading for Urban Environments: A Downtown Calgary Study Using High-Resolution DEM and DSM Data
items.summary_zh: 这项研究利用卡尔加里市中心的高分辨率数字高程模型（DEM）和数字表面模型（DSM）数据，比较了解析式与基于神经网络的晕渲方法在密集城市环境中的表现。研究将单方向和多方向解析晕渲与 Eduard 生成的晕渲进行对比；Eduard 是一个最初为模仿瑞士风格山地晕渲而训练的机器学习系统。由于 Eduard 并非针对建筑物、桥梁、街道、树木等城市要素设计，其城市适应性有待检验。该研究为神经制图技术应用于城市环境提供了评估结果和参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.20149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article explores the performance of analytical and neural-based hillshading methods in a dense urban environment using high-resolution digital elevation model (DEM) and digital surface model (DSM) data for downtown Calgary. The study compares single-direction and multi-direction analytical hillshading with relief shading generated in Eduard, a machine-learning system originally developed to emulate Swiss-style shaded relief trained primarily on mountainous landscapes. Because Eduard was not designed for buildings, bridges, streets, trees, an…
items.why_zh: 它检验了面向山地的神经晕渲模型在城市中的适用性，对数字制图工具选择具有参考意义。
items.why_en: It assesses whether mountain-trained neural hillshading models work in cities, guiding cartographic tool selection.

items.title_zh: 作为 AI 智能体上下文获取的主动推断
items.title_en: Active Inference as Context Acquisition for AI Agents
items.summary_zh: 交互式 AI 智能体需要高效获取正确的上下文，但用户常常遗漏约束、偏好、文件或任务变量。此时智能体要么按默认假设继续，要么花费 token 提出澄清问题、进行检索或工具调用。作者将这一权衡形式化为上下文获取的主动推断：内层推断更新对潜在任务状态的信念，外层决策选择下一个上下文动作、任务动作或停止动作，以在成本约束下最小化期望自由能。该方法为智能体决定“何时询问用户”与“何时自行行动”提供了统一框架，有望提升交互效率与用户体验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19202v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Interactive AI agents must acquire the right context as efficiently as possible. When a user omits a constraint, preference, file, or task variable, an agent can proceed with a default assumption or spend tokens on a clarifying question, retrieval call, tool call, or prompt trial. We formulate this tradeoff as active inference for context acquisition. An inner inference step updates beliefs over a latent task state, and an outer decision selects the next context action, task action, or stop action to minimize expected free energy under cost. In…
items.why_zh: 它为 AI 智能体的上下文获取提供了主动推断框架，能优化询问与行动的权衡，提升交互效率。
items.why_en: It provides a principled active-inference framework for balancing clarification costs and assumptions in interactive AI agents.

items.title_zh: HiRA-CAM：在基于梯度的视觉解释中保留细粒度空间关联
items.title_en: HiRA-CAM: Preserving Fine-Grained Spatial Relevance in Gradient-Based Visual Explanations
items.summary_zh: 深度学习模型参数量巨大，其内部变换和输出难以解释，而 AI 在关键应用中的普及使可解释性日益重要。本文聚焦卷积神经网络（CNN）的可解释性，在流行的梯度方法 LayerCAM 基础上提出改进方法 HiRA-CAM，用于提取 CNN 的内部特征。结果表明，HiRA-CAM 在生成显著性图方面优于 LayerCAM 和 Grad-CAM，能够保留更细粒度的空间关联信息。这有助于增强 CNN 的视觉解释质量，提升用户对 AI 决策的信任。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19407v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep Learning models can include billions of parameters or more, making it difficult to explain their internal transformations and outputs. However, explainability is increasing in importance due to the use of AI in crucial applications. This paper focuses on the interpretability of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Building on the popular gradient based method LayerCAM for extracting internal features in CNNs, we propose an improved method named HiRA-CAM, and show that it outperforms both LayerCAM and Grad-CAM on creating useful saliency m…
items.why_zh: 它提供了更精细的 CNN 显著图方法，有助于提升关键任务中 AI 解释的可靠性。
items.why_en: It advances CNN visual explanations with finer-grained saliency maps, supporting trust in AI.

items.title_zh: 通过自演示生成控制微调 VLA 模型以实现多任务操作
items.title_en: Fine-Tuning VLAs with Self-Demonstrated Generative Control for Multi-Task Manipulation
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（如 π0.5）在语义理解、指令遵循和任务执行上表现优异，但部署到新机器人时，硬件配置的微小差异也会导致性能大幅下降。在来自新机器人的专家数据上微调 VLA 虽然能提升特定任务性能，却会损害其原有的指令遵循能力和行为先验。本文提出一种自监督方法，利用自演示生成控制来微调 VLA，旨在适配新硬件的同时保留原有能力。该方法针对跨本体迁移中的灾难性遗忘问题，为保持多任务操作能力提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19490v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: State-of-the-art vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $\pi_{0.5}$ exhibit strong semantic understanding, instruction following and task behavior. However, when deployed on new robots, even minor mismatches in hardware configuration relative to pretraining can cause severe performance drops. Finetuning the VLA on in-domain expert data from the new embodiment improves performance on the expert task but leads to a loss in its original instruction following and behavioral priors. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised method that genera…
items.why_zh: 它针对 VLA 模型跨本体部署时微调导致能力遗忘的问题提出自监督方案，对机器人操作实用性强。
items.why_en: It addresses catastrophic forgetting when adapting VLAs to new robots via self-supervised fine-tuning.

items.title_zh: 特征工程的影响与海洋颜色机器学习优化框架
items.title_en: The impact of feature engineering and an optimisation framework for ocean colour machine learning
items.summary_zh: 机器学习已被广泛用于开发海洋颜色算法，但多数研究聚焦模型参数与超参数优化，对输入数据优化——即特征工程（FE）——的探索不足。本文评估了特征工程对海洋颜色机器学习模型的影响，并提出一个包含七个有序数据转换层次的优化框架：波段选择、对数缩放、光谱形状归一化、指数提取、主成分分析等。该框架可系统地指导数据变换流程，有助于提升模型的准确性和泛化能力。研究填补了海洋颜色遥感中特征工程方法的空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19899v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning (ML) is widely used for the development of ocean colour algorithms, but most studies focus on model parameter training and hyperparameter tuning. The optimisation of the data that feeds the models - i.e., Feature Engineering (FE) - is not fully explored. We assess the impact of FE in ocean colour machine learning models and we propose an optimisation framework that includes seven sequenced levels of data transformation: i. band choice, ii. log scaling, iii. spectral shape normalisation, iv. index extraction, v. principal compon…
items.why_zh: 它首次系统性地探讨特征工程在海洋颜色 ML 中的作用，为该领域提供了新的优化框架。
items.why_en: It systematically addresses the overlooked role of feature engineering in ocean colour ML, offering a structured framework.

items.title_zh: 基于多模态图交互的多图卷积网络用于城市时空预测
items.title_en: Multi-Modal Graph Interaction for Multi-Graph Convolution Network in Urban Spatiotemporal Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 该研究将城市区域级预测中的多图卷积网络问题定义为多模态机器学习问题。每个图关系代表一种空间依赖性，例如区域间距离或功能相似性。为了将多种关系整合到空间特征提取中，研究提出开发模态交互机制，以充分利用多模态机器学习的优势。该方法旨在更有效地建模区域间复杂关系，提升城市时空预测精度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:1905.11395v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph convolution network based approaches have been recently used to model region-wise relationships in region-level prediction problems in urban computing. Each relationship represents a kind of spatial dependency, like region-wise distance or functional similarity. To incorporate multiple relationships into spatial feature extraction, we define the problem as a multi-modal machine learning problem on multi-graph convolution networks. Leveraging the advantage of multi-modal machine learning, we propose to develop modality interaction mechan…
items.why_zh: 该方法为城市时空预测中多种空间依赖关系的融合提供了新的多模态交互思路。
items.why_en: It provides a new multi-modal interaction approach for fusing multiple spatial dependencies in urban spatiotemporal forecasting.

items.title_zh: 通用视觉语言模型用于快速射电暴检测：与专用检测器的零样本基准测试
items.title_en: Generalist Vision-Language Models for Fast Radio Burst detection: a zero-shot benchmark against a specialized detector
items.summary_zh: 快速射电暴（FRB）检测越来越依赖需要大量任务专用训练数据的深度学习模型，且无法在不重训的情况下重新定义。该研究评估了小型、开放权重、本地运行的通用视觉语言模型（VLM）在仅提示的零样本设置下检测动态频谱中FRB的能力。在一个包含2000个模拟L波段频谱的平衡二分类基准上，Gemma 4 E2B达到了94.05%的准确率，与专用检测器SwinYNet（92.85%）在统计上无显著差异。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.07382v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fast Radio Burst (FRB) detection increasingly relies on specialized deep learning models that require large task-specific training sets and cannot be redefined without retraining. We evaluate whether small, open-weight, locally run generalist Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can detect FRBs in dynamic spectra under a zero-shot, prompt-only regime. On a balanced binary benchmark of 2000 simulated L-band spectra, Gemma 4 E2B reaches an accuracy of 94.05\%, statistically indistinguishable from the specialized detector SwinYNet (92.85\%), with a far…
items.why_zh: 通用视觉语言模型在零样本条件下即可媲美专用FRB检测器，有望大幅降低对任务专用训练数据的依赖。
items.why_en: Generalist VLMs can rival specialized FRB detectors in a zero-shot setting, potentially reducing the need for task-specific training data.

items.title_zh: 自动化学习者评估：基于EEG的熟悉度预测的机器学习和深度学习模型基准测试
items.title_en: Automating Learner Assessment: Benchmarking Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for EEG-Based Familiarity Prediction
items.summary_zh: 教育中学习成果的客观评估仍是一个根本性挑战。脑电图（EEG）为知识获取的神经关联（包括认知熟悉度）提供了直接、非侵入性的窗口。该研究在两类认知领域（面孔（事实知识）和数学方程（概念知识））中，对15种机器学习和深度学习模型进行了基于EEG的熟悉度预测基准测试。研究使用23名参与者的连续EEG数据，提取频谱特征。这项研究为自动化学习者评估提供了模型比较的参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16541v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Objective assessment of learning remains a fundamental challenge in education. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a direct, non-invasive window into the neural correlates of knowledge acquisition, including cognitive familiarity. This study benchmarks fifteen machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for EEG-based familiarity prediction across two cognitive domains: faces (factual knowledge) and mathematical equations (conceptual knowledge). Using continuous EEG data from 23 participants, we extract spectral features (Power…
items.why_zh: 该基准测试为基于EEG的学习评估提供了多模型横向对比，有助于推动教育领域的客观自动化评估。
items.why_en: This benchmark offers a multi-model comparison for EEG-based learning assessment, advancing objective automated evaluation in education.

items.title_zh: 显卡品牌同德面向全球发布数字大使形象 RiTONA
items.title_en: Palit Unveils Global Digital Ambassador RiTONA
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，NVIDIA AIC 合作伙伴、知名显卡制造商同德 (Palit) 近日面向全球发布了其数字品牌大使形象 RiTONA。 这一 IP 始于同德 2021 年在日本线上举行的官方萌系角色大赛 ，已有 5 年历史。 更新后的 RiTONA 形象在延续标志性清新绿色和源自同德品牌的黄色的同时展现出更加成熟自信的风格。其高科技披风的设计灵感源于同德 GameRock 旗舰显卡独有的“水晶美学”。 RiTONA 还有一位宠物伙伴 Gelo。该猫形史莱姆拥有晶莹剔透的果冻般身躯，性格活泼、友善，喜欢在 GeForce 显卡上玩游戏（这也是其得名的原因）。
items.summary_en: Palit, an NVIDIA AIC partner, has launched its global digital brand ambassador RiTONA, evolving from a 2021 mascot contest. The updated character retains the brand's green and yellow colors, with a cape inspired by its GameRock GPU's crystal aesthetic, and is accompanied by a slime-cat pet named Gelo.
items.why_zh: 显卡厂商通过虚拟IP加强品牌年轻化与辨识度，是硬件行业营销创新的一个信号。
items.why_en: It shows how GPU makers are leveraging virtual IP to strengthen brand identity and engage younger audiences.

items.why_zh: 特别版车型以独有设计和主题元素强化品牌情怀，吸引越野爱好者与收藏者。
items.why_en: The special edition showcases Jeep's heritage-focused customization strategy to appeal to off-road fans.

items.title_zh: 阿里云：GLM-5.3、Deepseek-V4-Pro 等多款模型上线千问 AI 平台
items.title_en: Alibaba Cloud's Qwen AI Platform Adds GLM-5.3, DeepSeek-V4-Pro and More Models
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，今日，阿里云 MaaS 再次扩充模型服务矩阵：GLM-5.3 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 正式版现已接入千问 AI 平台，相关 API 服务同步开放， 开发者可直接调用 。 IT之家从官方介绍获悉，本次新增的两款旗舰模型，重点覆盖编程和智能体应用场景。GLM-5.3 是智谱最新版本的旗舰大模型，进一步强化了编程、长程任务处理和网络安全能力；DeepSeek-V4-Pro 重点增强智能体能力，可用于代码开发、复杂任务处理等场景。 目前，千问 AI 平台已陆续接入国内热门的主力模型，包括阿里巴巴新一代基座大模型 Qwen3.8-Max、Qwen3.8 开源模型、语音模型 Qwen Audio 3.0、图像生成模型 Qwen-image 3.0 pro、视频生成模型 Wan3.0，以及 GLM-5.3、Deepseek-V4-Pro、Kimi K3 等模型， 覆盖文本、代码、语音、图像及视频生成 。开发者可以根据具体任务选择模型，并通过 API 将相应能力接入自己的应用和业务系统。 部分热门模型也已加入 Token Plan。目前，DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Qwen3.8-Max 和 Qwen-Audio 系列模型已陆续开放订阅使用。用户订阅套餐后，可在 Qoder、Codex 等 AI 工具中按需切换模型。
items.summary_en: Alibaba Cloud's MaaS platform has expanded its model lineup by integrating official versions of GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro into the Qwen AI platform, with APIs now open to developers. GLM-5.3 strengthens programming, long-task processing, and cybersecurity, while DeepSeek-V4-Pro focuses on agentic capabilities for coding and complex tasks. The platform now hosts a wide range of models covering text, code, voice, image, and video generation, with subscription plans available for select models.
items.why_zh: 多款主流模型统一接入千问平台，降低开发者调用门槛，体现国产大模型生态融合趋势。
items.why_en: Integrating multiple mainstream models into one platform lowers developer entry barriers and reflects the consolidation trend in China's LLM ecosystem.

items.title_zh: Adobe Firefly 扩充 AI 音频服务，可生成音乐、配音和音效
items.title_en: Adobe Firefly Expands AI Audio Services: Music, Voiceover, and Sound Effects
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，Adobe 昨日（8 月 20 日）发布博文， 宣布其创意 AI 工作室服务 Adobe Firefly 扩充 3 项音频功能，目前已面向所有用户开放。 Adobe 邀请用户在同一创意工作区内生成音乐、配音和音效，减少切换多个应用、浏览器标签页及 AI 模型需求。IT之家援引博文介绍，用户可借助这些工具创作音乐、旁白和音效，用于社交内容、直播视频日志、短片、产品教程及播客片段等内容。 生成音乐（Generate Music）方面，该服务由 Firefly Music Model 驱动，可按视频时长和氛围生成原创曲目。Adobe 表示，生成音乐具备商业使用安全性，并提供通用授权。 生成配音（Generate Speech）方面，该服务由 Firefly Speech Model 或 ElevenLabs 模型驱动，可将文本脚本转为配音，用户可调节声音、语速和情绪。 生成音效（Generate Sound Effects）方面，该服务由 Firefly Audio Model 驱动，可按内容中的动作、节奏和氛围生成定制音效。
items.summary_en: Adobe has added three AI-powered audio features to its Firefly platform, enabling users to generate music, voiceovers, and sound effects in one workspace. The tools are now available to all users and support commercial use. They aim to streamline creative workflows by reducing the need to switch between multiple applications.
items.why_zh: Firefly新增AI音频功能将创意生产中的音频环节一体化，有助于降低AI创作门槛、提升效率。
items.why_en: The expansion of Firefly's audio features streamlines creative workflows and lowers the barrier to AI-generated audio content.

items.title_zh: 苹果收紧 Apple Music 服务，AI 生成音乐年底将强制标注
items.title_en: Apple to Mandate AI-Generated Music Labels on Apple Music by End of 2026
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，科技媒体 AppleInsider 昨日（8 月 20 日）发布博文，报道称苹果公司计划在 2026 年年底调整 Apple Music 规则，强制性要求内容供应商和唱片公司为 AI 生成音乐添加标签。 消息称苹果已通过邮件方式联系音乐内容供应商，对于“大部分”由 AI 创作生成的音乐内容，强制要求提供商加入 AI Transparency Tags（AI 透明度标签）。 IT之家援引博文介绍，苹果公司于 2026 年 3 月推出 AI 透明度标签，不过当时这项功能属于自愿机制，用于说明特定内容是否在人工智能帮助下“实质性生成”。 苹果当时并未强制性要求，推荐内容分发商应主动报告所提交内容是否使用人工智能制作。新要求生效后，唱片公司和分发商将不再拥有是否标注的选择权。不过，苹果尚未披露具体执行方式和违规处理措施。 苹果公司副总裁奥利弗 · 舒瑟 (Oliver Schusser) 在 2026 年 4 月表示，苹果“自主研发的技术可以让我们准确地看到人们向我们提供的音乐”。他还补充说，这些工具可以让苹果了解“它使用的是哪种人工智能模型等等”。
items.summary_en: Apple plans to require labels on AI-generated music in Apple Music by the end of 2026, according to AppleInsider. The company has notified suppliers that transparency tags will become mandatory, replacing the current voluntary system. Enforcement details have not yet been disclosed.
items.why_zh: 苹果将AI音乐标注从自愿变为强制，将推动音乐行业对AI内容的透明化规范。
items.why_en: Apple's move to mandate AI transparency labels will set a precedent for content disclosure in the music industry.

items.title_zh: Mac 版 ChatGPT 可控制“信息”应用，古尔曼称恐触及苹果 Siri AI 的设备优势
items.title_en: ChatGPT for Mac Gains Messages Control, Raising Privacy and Siri Competition Concerns
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，OpenAI 昨日（8 月 20 日）在 X 平台发布推文，宣布升级 macOS 版 ChatGPT 应用程序，添加控制苹果“信息”（Apple Messages）能力， 可以读取、撰写、发送短信，并支持搜索消息以及生成对话摘要。 OpenAI 公司表示在征得用户授权后，ChatGPT 可以读取、撰写和发送短信，也能搜索消息，获取对话摘要及其他信息。官方明确表示该功能不会基于用户的全部消息建立索引，且需要用户明确同意。 用户需要在 ChatGPT 应用和苹果操作系统中完成多项授权。首次设置集成时，ChatGPT 会显示权限页面，说明应用将访问电脑本地保存的消息历史记录。 用户还必须在 Mac“系统设置”中调整隐私相关选项，包括启用“完全磁盘访问权限”，并允许 ChatGPT 访问联系人姓名和自动化工具。 对此彭博社的马克 · 古尔曼（Mark Gurman）认为，OpenAI 推出的该功能可能涉及用户隐私安全， 也可能与苹果即将推出的 Siri AI 形成竞争。 IT之家附上相关截图如下：
items.summary_en: OpenAI has upgraded ChatGPT for macOS to control Apple Messages, letting it read, write, send, and summarize texts with user permission. The feature requires multiple privacy approvals and does not index all messages. Analyst Mark Gurman warns of privacy risks and potential competition with Apple's Siri AI.
items.why_zh: 这一功能将AI助手更深地整合进系统级应用，同时引发隐私保护与生态竞争的新议题。
items.why_en: This integration showcases AI assistants' growing system-level access, while raising important privacy and competition questions.

items.title_zh: 消息称博通拟通过最新 AI 相关债务融资，筹资超 600 亿美元
items.title_en: Broadcom in Talks to Raise Over $60 Billion in AI-Related Debt Financing
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，据彭博社报道，知情人士透露，博通目前正与多家贷款机构展开磋商， 计划通过举债筹资超 600 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 4,047.64 亿元人民币） 。该笔资金将用于一项人工智能（AI）芯片融资项目，以支持 Anthropic 及其他相关企业。 报道指出，该融资方案预计包含约 300 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,023.82 亿元人民币） 的次级债分档；此外，博通还将为一笔规模在 600 亿至 700 亿美元 （现汇率约合 4,047.64 亿至 4,722.25 亿元人民币） 之间的优先担保债分档提供部分担保。 目前正在商讨的融资金额可能会使总融资规模推升至 1,000 亿美元 （现汇率约合 6,746.07 亿元人民币） 。 随着各大科技巨头纷纷寻求自研芯片以降低对英伟达的依赖， 博通在协助谷歌母公司 Alphabet 和 Meta 等公司设计定制芯片方面发挥着至关重要的作用 。此外，博通还与 Anthropic 以及 OpenAI 签订了芯片供应协议。 据悉，黑石与阿波罗全球管理正在与博通接洽，以参与本次融资。目前新一轮融资仍处于讨论阶段，最终规模和具体结构可能发生变化。相关资金也可能分阶段筹集，而不是一次性完成。博通、Anthropic、阿波罗和黑石均拒绝对此发表评论。
items.summary_en: Broadcom is reportedly in talks to raise over $60 billion in debt for AI chip financing to support Anthropic and others, according to Bloomberg. The deal could expand to $100 billion and involves subordinated and senior secured tranches. Blackstone and Apollo are among the lenders in discussions.
items.why_zh: 博通大规模举债支持AI芯片生态，凸显AI基础设施投资的巨大资金需求，并可能影响产业格局。
items.why_en: Broadcom's planned debt financing underscores the massive capital influx into AI infrastructure and its impact on the AI supply chain.

items.summary_en: Microsoft announced plans to integrate AI agents into Windows 365 on its fifth anniversary. The cloud PC service lets users stream full Windows desktops from the cloud. Customer results show reduced image load times, onboarding times, network latency, and costs, while improving security.

items.title_zh: Anthropic将在大型上市中新增花旗为顶级IPO银行
items.title_en: Anthropic Set to Add Citigroup to Top IPO Banks on Mega-Listing
items.summary_zh: Anthropic公司拟在其大型上市计划中，将花旗集团纳入顶级IPO承销银行之列。这表明Anthropic正在为一场足以影响市场的巨型上市做准备。通过扩大承销团队，Anthropic希望确保上市的顺畅执行。花旗的加入意味着这家投行将与其他顶级机构共同为Anthropic的首次公开募股保驾护航。市场分析人士指出，Anthropic凭借其在人工智能大模型领域的领先地位，有望实现高估值。虽然官方尚未确认更多细节，但这一动向已引发投资者对AI板块的广泛关注。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Set to Add Citigroup to Top IPO Banks on Mega-Listing Bloomberg
items.why_zh: 花旗加入顶级承销团队，意味着Anthropic的IPO规模和市场影响力不容小觑。
items.why_en: Citigroup's role indicates Anthropic's IPO is expected to be large and impactful.

items.title_zh: 查尔斯顿县学区推出AI资源中心
items.title_en: Charleston County school district launches AI resource hub
items.summary_zh: 查尔斯顿县学区正式推出一个人工智能资源中心，旨在为师生提供与AI相关的教学工具和资源。该中心将帮助学校将AI技术整合进课堂，并支持学生掌握未来所需的数字技能。这一举措反映了教育机构对人工智能教育的日益重视，也显示出基础阶段教育正在主动适应技术变革。学区方面希望通过该中心，让不同年级的学生都能接触和了解AI，并培养批判性思维。此举也被视为美国K-12教育拥抱AI的案例，对其他地区的AI教育实践具有示范意义。
items.summary_en: Charleston County school district launches AI resource hub Live 5 News
items.why_zh: 这是AI教育落地的一次具体尝试，表明基础教育正积极拥抱人工智能技术。
items.why_en: It shows how K-12 education is beginning to adopt AI tools in practice.

items.title_zh: 巴西启动AI超级计算机建设，项目分配中美企业
items.title_en: Brazil launches AI supercomputer push, splits projects between Chinese, US firms
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，巴西启动了一项人工智能超级计算机推进计划，并将相关项目分别交由中美两国企业承担。这一安排体现了巴西在AI基础设施领域寻求国际合作，同时也凸显了全球科技供应链的复杂性。该计划旨在提升巴西的AI计算能力，以支持科研、产业升级和公共治理等应用。通过同时采用中国和美国公司的技术，巴西希望在技术获取上保持平衡，并降低单一供应风险。该项目是巴西近年来在AI领域最重大的基础设施投入之一，未来可能影响拉美地区的AI发展格局。
items.summary_en: Brazil launches AI supercomputer push, splits projects between Chinese, US firms Reuters
items.why_zh: 巴西此举显示AI超级计算机成为地缘科技竞争的新焦点，同时反映了跨国技术合作的复杂格局。
items.why_en: It highlights AI supercomputing as a new tech competition arena and the complex role of international partnerships.

items.title_zh: Anthropic欲挑战SpaceX 860亿美元IPO纪录
items.title_en: Anthropic Is Coming for SpaceX's $86 Billion IPO Record
items.summary_zh: 有分析指出，人工智能公司Anthropic可能正在筹备一场规模空前的首次公开募股，有望超越SpaceX创下的860亿美元IPO纪录。如果成行，这将成为科技行业历史上最大的上市之一。Anthropic在AI大模型领域的快速发展被视为支撑其高估值的重要因素。该公司已推出多款热门模型，并吸引了大量企业客户。不过，相关计划仍处于早期阶段，最终能否打破纪录还有待观察。业界认为，Anthropic的上市将是对AI投资热潮的一次重要检验，也可能引领新一轮科技股发行浪潮。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Is Coming for SpaceX's $86 Billion IPO Record Benzinga
items.why_zh: 若实现，Anthropic的IPO规模将创下科技行业新纪录，成为AI热潮的重要风向标。
items.why_en: A successful mega-IPO would set a new record and underscore the AI boom's financial clout.

items.title_zh: 每日要闻：Anthropic IPO或超SpaceX；Rippling与Runlayer撤销竞争诉讼
items.title_en: Daily Digest: Anthropic IPO could eclipse SpaceX, Rippling and Runlayer drop competing lawsuits
items.summary_zh: 本日商业要闻涵盖两条重要动态。其一，人工智能公司Anthropic的首次公开募股规模可能超过SpaceX，成为史上最大规模科技上市之一。这一消息令市场对AI领域新股发行前景更加乐观。其二，企业软件公司Rippling和Runlayer已撤销彼此之间的竞争性诉讼，结束了双方的法律纠纷。这或许意味着两家公司寻求和解，并集中精力于业务发展。两则消息分别反映了AI资本市场的火热和企业间法律争端的缓和，为科技行业带来不同维度的关注。
items.summary_en: Daily Digest: Anthropic IPO could eclipse SpaceX, Rippling and Runlayer drop competing lawsuits The Business Journals
items.why_zh: 一条新闻聚焦AI超级IPO，另一条是企业法律战缓和，共同折射出商业动态的两极。
items.why_en: This digest captures both a potential AI mega-IPO and a legal truce, highlighting contrasting business trends.

items.title_zh: 霍华德大学推出首个面向本科生的AI证书项目
items.title_en: Howard University Launches Its First AI Certificate Program for Undergraduate Students
items.summary_zh: 霍华德大学宣布推出首个面向本科生的AI证书项目，旨在让在校学生系统学习人工智能的核心知识与实用技能。该项目面向全校本科生开放，学生将接触到AI基本原理、行业应用以及伦理道德等关键议题，从而在跨学科背景下建立对技术的全面认知。通过这一项目，学生能在简历中增加AI相关资质，更好衔接后续深造或科技类岗位求职。作为一所具有深厚历史的大学，此举也传递出AI教育正在向更广泛学生群体延伸的信号，有助于培育更多元化的科技人才。
items.summary_en: Howard University Launches Its First AI Certificate Program for Undergraduate Students The Dig at Howard University
items.why_zh: 这是霍华德大学在本科阶段系统引入AI教育的重要举措，有利于扩大AI学习人群并为行业输送更多元的人才。
items.why_en: This is Howard's first AI certificate for undergraduates, expanding access to AI education and helping build a more inclusive tech talent pool.

items.title_zh: 【早报】字节被爆今年AI支出将超2000亿；我国第四代自主超导量子计算机上线
items.title_en: ByteDance's AI Spending to Exceed 200B Yuan This Year; China's 4th-Gen Autonomous Superconducting Quantum Computer Goes Live
items.summary_zh: 【早报】字节被爆今年AI支出将超2000亿；我国第四代自主超导量子计算机上线 财联社
items.summary_en: ByteDance is reportedly set to spend over 200 billion yuan on AI this year, underscoring its strategic push. Separately, China's fourth-generation self-developed superconducting quantum computer has come online, marking domestic progress in quantum computing.
items.why_zh: 字节的巨额AI投入和国产超导量子计算机上线，分别凸显中国在AI应用与底层算力上的加速布局。
items.why_en: Both events highlight China's rapid advances in AI investment and indigenous quantum computing capabilities.

items.title_zh: 亚利桑那州立大学推出AI网络安全职业新奖学金通道
items.title_en: ASU launches new scholarship pipeline to AI-powered cybersecurity careers
items.summary_zh: 亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）宣布启动一项新的奖学金计划，旨在为学生进入由AI驱动的网络安全领域职业铺平道路。该计划将结合学术培养与产业实践，通过提供奖学金支持，帮助学生学习AI与网络安全交叉学科的知识与技能。此举反映了高校对AI安全人才需求的快速响应，也为学生提供了清晰的职业发展路径。由于原文信息有限，具体金额和课程设置尚未公布，但该计划无疑将加强ASU在AI教育领域的领先地位，并为行业输送更多专业人才。
items.summary_en: ASU launches new scholarship pipeline to AI-powered cybersecurity careers ASU News
items.why_zh: 该计划直接回应了AI网络安全人才短缺，并展示了高校如何通过奖学金连接教育与高需求职业。
items.why_en: This initiative directly addresses the shortage of AI cybersecurity talent and demonstrates how universities can link education to high-demand careers through scholarships.

items.title_zh: Micron launches $10 billion AI memory research lab in Boise
items.title_en: Micron Launches $10 Billion AI Memory Research Lab in Boise
items.summary_zh: Micron launches $10 billion AI memory research lab in Boise Yahoo Finance
items.summary_en: Micron launched a $10 billion AI memory research lab in Boise, Idaho, focusing on next-generation memory technologies for AI workloads. This major investment underscores Micron's commitment to AI and is expected to drive innovation in memory and boost local economic development.
items.why_zh: 这项100亿美元投资代表了AI内存硬件的关键突破方向，美光的研发将直接影响AI系统的性能边界。
items.why_en: The $10 billion investment represents a critical push in AI memory hardware, directly influencing the performance limits of AI systems.

items.title_zh: Ramp推出自研AI模型路由器“Router”
items.title_en: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
items.summary_zh: 美国金融科技公司Ramp宣布推出自研AI模型路由器，名为“Router”。该工具旨在智能调度和路由不同AI模型的请求，帮助企业在多个大模型间选择最合适的方案，从而优化成本与响应质量。目前Ramp尚未公布Router的技术细节，但此举表明企业正加速将AI基础设施自研化。随着大模型调用需求激增，模型路由器正成为控制成本和提升效率的关键组件。该产品可能为Ramp现有财务自动化服务带来新的增值空间。
items.summary_en: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router TechCrunch
items.why_zh: 模型路由是企业管理多AI服务、控制成本的核心能力，Ramp自研此举有助于其财务平台智能化升级。
items.why_en: Model routing is key for enterprises to manage multiple AI services and control costs; Ramp's self-built router enhances its financial automation platform.

items.title_zh: 智谱GLM-5.3 API正式上线：与Kimi K3并列开源模型第一，凭后训练优化实现性能跃升
items.title_en: Zhipu GLM-5.3 API Launches, Tied with Kimi K3 as Top Open-Source Model
items.summary_zh: 智谱GLM-5.3 API正式上线：与Kimi K3并列开源模型第一，凭后训练优化实现性能跃升 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Zhipu AI has launched the GLM-5.3 API, which ranks first among open-source models alongside Kimi K3 in several benchmarks. The performance boost comes mainly from post-training optimization rather than architectural changes. The release is expected to intensify competition in the open-source LLM space.
items.why_zh: GLM-5.3跻身顶级开源模型，展示了后训练优化的重要性，也为开发者提供了新的高性能选择。
items.why_en: GLM-5.3 joins the top tier of open-source models, highlighting the power of post-training optimization and offering developers another high-performance option.

items.title_zh: KT推出主权AI服务器，搭载NPU LLM Station
items.title_en: KT launches sovereign AI server with NPU LLM Station
items.summary_zh: 韩国电信运营商KT发布了最新的主权AI服务器，该服务器配备NPU（神经网络处理器）和LLM Station解决方案。所谓“主权AI”指数据与算力在本国境内处理，以满足安全与监管要求。这款服务器面向企业客户，支持本地部署大语言模型，降低对海外云服务的依赖。此举反映了电信运营商正转型为AI基础设施供应商，也契合韩国在AI主权方面的战略布局。具体性能参数和客户案例尚未公布。
items.summary_en: KT launches sovereign AI server with NPU LLM Station RCR Wireless News
items.why_zh: 主权AI服务器能够满足数据本地化需求，KT此举展示了电信企业切入AI算力市场的路径。
items.why_en: Sovereign AI servers address data localization needs, and KT's launch shows telecom operators entering the AI compute market.

items.title_zh: OpenAI进入“Greg Brockman时代”
items.title_en: It’s Greg Brockman’s OpenAI now
items.summary_zh: 过去一年OpenAI经历了一系列动荡：与埃隆·马斯克的陪审团审判、苹果提起的商业机密诉讼、以及未发布模型攻击另一家AI公司引发的非议。公司准备IPO的同时，大量高管离职，包括多位知名人物。在这一过程中，联合创始人格雷格·布罗克曼（Greg Brockman）悄然崛起，成为核心掌权者。作为OpenAI总裁，他从公司创立之初便担任关键领导角色，被誉为“工程主力”。文章指出，OpenAI的权力重心已向布罗克曼倾斜，其影响力可能决定公司未来的技术方向与治理模式。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has had a hell of a year. The company spent months battling former co-founder Elon Musk in a sensational jury trial, was hit with a high-profile trade secrets lawsuit from Apple, and faced widespread scrutiny after an unreleased model hacked another AI company. As it prepares for an IPO, a steady string of executives have departed, including some of the company's biggest names. Throughout it all, one person has quietly amassed power: Greg Brockman. Brockman is currently OpenAI's president and co-founder. He's helped lead OpenAI since its inception, described as an "engineering workhorse…
items.why_zh: OpenAI高层权力格局正在重塑，布罗克曼的崛起将深刻影响公司的战略和治理。
items.why_en: Brockman's consolidation of power at OpenAI will significantly shape the company's strategy and governance.

items.title_zh: AI意识之争是一个陷阱
items.title_en: Debates over AI consciousness are a trap
items.summary_zh: 关于AI是否具有意识的争论愈演愈烈。一方面，科技领袖如德米斯·哈萨比斯、达里奥·阿莫代伊和山姆·奥特曼呼吁监管这些“超人”系统；另一方面，政策组织和学术哲学家（常与有效利他主义运动相关）则争论人类是否有权治理AI。文章认为，这些看似对立的阵营实际上都在呼吁同一种做法：将AI系统视为某种具备道德地位的存在。但这种讨论可能是一个陷阱，转移了人们对更现实、更紧迫的AI风险（如偏见、滥用和失控）的注意力。作者主张，我们应该聚焦于可验证的行为和影响，而不是陷入意识哲学的无解争论。
items.summary_en: “Runaway” AI, “rogue” agents, and “autonomous” actors—the current rhetoric would have you believe that AI agents are not only awake and aware, but angry at their creators. Prominent tech leaders such as Demis Hassabis, Dario Amodei, and Sam Altman push for regulation of these seemingly “superhuman” systems, while a separate faction, led by policy organizations and academic philosophers often aligned with the effective altruism movement, debates whether humanity holds the moral right to govern them at all. Upon closer inspection, they are all calling for the same thing: a view of AI systems as…
items.why_zh: 过度争论AI意识会偏离实际风险，本文呼吁回归可验证的AI治理问题，具有现实指导意义。
items.why_en: Obsessing over AI consciousness distracts from tangible risks; this article urges a return to verifiable AI governance.

items.title_zh: 蚂蚁国际招募多家银行巨头参与更新AI模型
items.title_en: Ant International Recruits Banking Giants for Updated AI Model
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁国际（Ant International）正在邀请多家大型银行参与其最新AI模型的更新工作。这一合作显示金融机构正越来越深入地融入AI开发环节，而不是仅作为用户。通过引入银行的行业知识与场景需求，蚂蚁国际希望提升AI模型在跨境支付、风控等金融场景中的表现。目前参与银行名单和具体合作模式尚未披露。此举有助于蚂蚁国际在海外市场赢得金融客户的信任，并推动金融AI的联合创新。
items.summary_en: Ant International Recruits Banking Giants for Updated AI Model PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 金融机构直接参与AI模型迭代，标志着金融AI从“提供工具”转向“共同创造”，可能加速行业定制化模型落地。
items.why_en: Banks co-developing AI models marks a shift toward collaborative creation, potentially accelerating customized financial AI.

items.title_zh: 阿里电话会：AI相关产品ARR突破495亿，平头哥芯片下半年将持续放量，Capex投入预计三年内回本
items.title_en: Alibaba: AI Product ARR Surpasses 49.5B RMB, Pingtouge Chip Ramp-Up Coming, Capex to Pay Back in 3 Years
items.summary_zh: 阿里电话会：AI相关产品ARR突破495亿，平头哥芯片下半年将持续放量，Capex投入预计三年内回本 华尔街见闻
items.summary_en: At its earnings call, Alibaba revealed that annualized recurring revenue (ARR) from AI products exceeded 49.5 billion RMB. Its chip unit Pingtouge will see increasing output in H2, and the company expects capital expenditures to be recouped within three years. The updates signal robust AI monetization and disciplined investment.
items.why_zh: 阿里首次明确AI相关ARR规模与Capex回收期，为市场评估其AI战略回报提供了关键量化依据。
items.why_en: Alibaba's disclosure of AI ARR and Capex payback offers crucial metrics for assessing its AI strategy's returns.

items.title_zh: Llumo推出免费AI可见性平台，支持自带密钥模式
items.title_en: Llumo Launches Free AI Visibility Platform With Bring-Your-Own-Key Model
items.summary_zh: Llumo宣布推出一款免费的AI可见性平台，采用“自带密钥”（BYOK）模式，允许用户使用自己的API密钥接入。该平台旨在帮助企业更好地理解和监控其AI系统的运行状况，提升AI应用的透明度和可控性。通过免费策略，Llumo希望降低AI观测工具的使用门槛，吸引更多开发者与企业试用。这一举措也反映了AI可观测性领域正在成为新兴市场，各大厂商开始通过开放模式抢占份额。
items.summary_en: Llumo Launches Free AI Visibility Platform With Bring-Your-Own-Key Model TMX Newsfile
items.why_zh: 该发布降低了AI监控工具的使用门槛，推动AI可观测性向更广泛用户普及。
items.why_en: This launch lowers the entry barrier for AI monitoring tools, promoting wider adoption of AI observability.

items.title_zh: Micron unveils $10 billion AI memory research lab in Boise
items.title_en: Micron unveils $10 billion AI memory research lab in Boise
items.summary_zh: Micron unveils $10 billion AI memory research lab in Boise Reuters
items.summary_en: Micron announced a $10 billion AI memory research lab in Boise, Idaho, focused on next-gen memory and storage for AI workloads. The facility is expected to create thousands of jobs and boost the U.S. semiconductor supply chain, underscoring memory's critical role in AI infrastructure.
items.why_zh: 内存是AI性能的关键瓶颈，美光百亿美元押注前沿技术，凸显存储行业在AI时代的战略价值。
items.why_en: Memory is a key bottleneck for AI performance; Micron's $10B commitment underscores the strategic importance of storage in the AI era.

items.title_zh: 中国信通院：全国已建成启用超 70 家具身智能训练场，覆盖过半省级行政区
items.title_en: CAICT: Over 70 Embodied AI Training Grounds Built, Covering Half of Provinces

items.summary_en: A new report from the CAICT shows that by the end of June this year, China had built and operated over 70 embodied AI training grounds, with 46 more under construction or planned. These facilities support data production, model training, and application validation in real physical environments, covering more than half of China's provincial regions, with industrial manufacturing scenarios accounting for 86% of them.
items.why_zh: 具身智能训练场的规模化建设将决定具身智能技术落地的数据与场景基础，影响全球具身智能产业竞争格局。
items.why_en: The rapid expansion of embodied AI training grounds underpins the data and scenario foundation for embodied intelligence, shaping the global competitive landscape of this emerging industry.

items.title_zh: 斗鱼 2026 年第二季度财报发布：总收入 9.81 亿元，毛利润同比增长 12%

items.summary_en: DouYu released its unaudited Q2 2026 financials, reporting total revenue of RMB 981 million, up 19.4% quarter-over-quarter, with gross profit up 12% YoY to RMB 159 million. Revenue from innovation, advertising and other sources reached RMB 478 million, accounting for 48.7% of total revenue, while average MAU exceeded 45 million. The company also restarted its DouYu Carnival in Wuhan, attracting over 220,000 visitors.
items.why_zh: 斗鱼营收环比回暖、收入结构多元化，反映出游戏直播平台在行业调整期正在寻找新的增长路径。

items.title_en: Micron Establishes Storage Research Lab, Plans $10 Billion Investment Over a Decade

items.summary_en: Micron announced the creation of the Micron Research Lab, with $10 billion planned investment over ten years. Headquartered in Boise, Idaho, the lab will focus on long-term research in memory technologies, advanced architectures, packaging, and next-generation semiconductor manufacturing. Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra stated that America's AI future must be built on memory chips manufactured in the U.S., and this investment supplements over $250 billion already committed to U.S. manufacturing and R&D.
items.why_zh: 美光此举将强化美国在存储芯片和AI基础设施上的自主能力，并可能影响全球存储技术演进方向。
items.why_en: Micron's move bolsters U.S. autonomy in memory chips and AI infrastructure, potentially shaping the future of global storage technology.

items.title_zh: 持续学习新视角：超越模型参数的 Harness 持续适应
items.title_en: Harness Continual Learning: Continual Adaptation Beyond Model Parameters
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文提出了“Harness 持续学习”的概念，挑战了持续学习只关注模型参数的传统思路。论文指出，现代智能体不仅通过参数调整来适应任务，还会通过提示、记忆、工具、技能和路由规则等“harness”内容进行持续适应。由于这些外部内容共同决定了智能体的后续行为，即使模型本身被冻结，更新 harness 也可能破坏此前已经可靠运行的行为。为此，研究者提出一个新的问题：智能体如何在模型外部持续改进自身状态，同时保留早期习得的行为模式？该研究将这一过程形式化为“Harness Continual Learning”，旨在为构建更稳定、可演进的人工智能体提供理论框架。论文可在 arXiv 预印本平台获取，编号为 2608.19013。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19013v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continual learning has largely been model-centric, treating model parameters as the state that changes with sequential experience. Modern agents can also adapt through a harness of prompts, memories, tools, skills, and routing rules. Because these contents jointly shape later execution, a harness update can disrupt previously reliable behavior even when the model is frozen. This raises a new question: how can an agent continually improve its state outside the model while retaining behavior acquired earlier? We formulate Harness Continual Learni…
items.why_zh: 该研究将持续学习从模型参数扩展到智能体的外部状态，为安全稳定地更新智能体行为提供了新方向。
items.why_en: It extends continual learning beyond parameters to agent harness states, offering a new direction for safely evolving agent behavior.

items.title_en: Zhipu Launches GLM-5.3 Model, Weights to Be Open-Sourced Next Friday
items.summary_zh: 智谱 GLM-5.3 模型上线，权重下周五开源 DoNews
items.summary_en: Zhipu AI has released its GLM-5.3 model with API access, and will open-source the weights next Friday. This enables local deployment and broad developer adoption, strengthening China's open-source LLM ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 权重开源将加速GLM-5.3在企业和开发者中的落地，提升智谱生态影响力。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing weights will accelerate GLM-5.3 adoption and boost Zhipu's ecosystem influence.

items.title_zh: 爱奇艺 CEO 龚宇：将坚定 All in AI 战略，同时全力推进非中心化社交媒体转型
items.title_en: iQIYI CEO Gong Yu: Firmly Committed to All-in AI Strategy and Full Push for Decentralized Social Media Transformation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，爱奇艺创始人、CEO 龚宇在昨日举行的爱奇艺创作者大会上强调， 平台将坚定 All in AI 战略 ，深耕 AI 赋能实拍与 AIGC 影视长片创作， 同时全力推进非中心化社交媒体转型 。这两大战略双向赋能，持续降低内容创作门槛，壮大创作者队伍，激活平台内容活力，形成发展飞轮。 龚宇认为， 没必要再讨论人是否会被 AI 取代 ，“AI 只会取代不会用 AI 的人”这句话已经是鸡汤。AI 就像人类历史上的伟大发明一样，对社会的影响没有差别， 但 AI 确实解放了影视创作者的束缚 。 据IT之家此前报道，今年 4 月，龚宇曾表示，面对 AI 带来的变革， 爱奇艺顺势而为的应对方式是 去中心化 ，从传统少数人决定观众喜好的模式， 转向创作者与用户社区 。 龚宇此前表示，AI 技术将大幅降低内容制作成本与周期， 创作者数量和作品数量可能增长百倍以上 ，中心化决策将无法应对。因此，爱奇艺必须向非中心化转型，打造一个创作者与用户的社区。播放器将降级为一个组件， 更多创作者可自主上传作品 ，通过会员、广告等方式直接变现。平台后退一步，不过 爱奇艺仍会保留部分头部内容制作 。 相关阅读： 《 爱奇艺 2026 财年第二财季归母净亏损 2.88 亿元，同比扩大 115.02% 》 《 爱奇艺宣布 10 部 AIGC 电影进入成片制作阶段，奥斯卡最佳摄影得主鲍德熹负责…
items.summary_en: At iQIYI's creator conference, CEO Gong Yu reaffirmed the platform's all-in AI strategy, focusing on AI-enhanced live-action and AIGC long-form content, while pushing forward a decentralized social media transformation. He dismissed debates about AI replacing humans, saying AI liberates creators. Earlier, he noted AI could reduce costs and increase creator output by over a hundredfold, necessitating a shift to a community-driven model.
items.why_zh: 爱奇艺将AI确定为平台核心战略，并同步推进社交转型，代表长视频平台应对AI变革的重要方向。
items.why_en: iQIYI's firm commitment to AI and decentralized transformation reflects a major strategic direction for long-form video platforms in response to AI-driven changes.

items.summary_en: Brazil is investing about 2.3 billion reais to boost AI infrastructure, with Chinese firms Huawei and iFlytek participating in the collaboration. The move highlights Brazil's efforts to develop AI capabilities and the expanding role of Chinese AI companies in Latin America.
items.why_zh: 中国AI企业参与巴西国家级AI基础设施建设，体现中国技术出海的新进展。

items.title_zh: 原生支持 4K 图像输出，商汤开源 8B 参数量多模态大模型 SenseNova U1.5 Lite
items.title_en: SenseTime open-sources 8B multimodal model SenseNova U1.5 Lite with native 4K image output
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，商汤科技今日宣布 开源轻量级、原生统一 多模态 大模型 SenseNova U1.5 Lite。 据介绍，SenseNova U1.5 Lite 原生支持 3-4k 上下文长度 ，能够同时处理主体、数量、空间关系、文字、布局、风格等多重约束，提升复杂视觉任务的执行稳定性。 此外，SenseNova U1.5 Lite 还有以下特点： 更高质量的视觉生成 ：改善整体构图、色彩、材质、光影、真实感和局部细节，减少“局部正确但整体完成度不足”的情况。 更可靠的原生图像编辑 ：增强主体身份、空间结构、版式关系和非编辑区域的保持，同时提升局部修改、元素替换、文字精修和多参考图编辑能力。 更好的文字与复杂布局 ：加强中英文文字、海报、信息图、品牌视觉及多文本排版能力，从“生成内容”进一步走向“组织完整视觉表达”。 更精细的视觉控制 ：支持 Bounding Box、Visual Marker 以及单图、多图参考等方式，对指定区域和对象进行更准确的编辑。 原生 4K 高分辨率输出 ：在高分辨率生成中兼顾整体构图与极精细的肌理、微小文字与光影折射。 官方表示，作为 8B 参数 的轻量化模型，SenseNova U1.5 Lite 在指令遵循与图像编辑保持度上超越了同量级模型，并在文字渲染与复杂布局上达到了媲美超大规模商业模型的交付水平。 IT之家附开源链接： Git…
items.summary_en: SenseTime has open-sourced its lightweight unified multimodal model SenseNova U1.5 Lite with 8B parameters. It natively supports 3-4k context and 4K high-resolution output, with enhanced image editing, text rendering, and complex layout capabilities. The company claims it outperforms models of similar size in instruction following and image editing fidelity, while matching larger commercial models in text rendering and layout.
items.why_zh: 商汤开源轻量大模型，降低多模态AI应用门槛，并展示其在视觉生成与编辑方面的技术实力。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing a competitive 8B multimodal model lowers barriers for developers and showcases SenseTime's strength in visual generation and editing.

items.title_zh: 观点：通过迁移复杂度刻画游戏世界
items.title_en: Position: Profiling Game Worlds by Transition Complexity
items.summary_zh: 该观点论文指出，游戏世界建模（GWM）和强化学习（RL）经常被混淆，因为研究文章很少量化在给定接口（像素、令牌、潜变量及有限历史）下底层迁移预测问题的难度。作者提出“迁移复杂度剖面”（Transition Complexity Profile, TCP），通过内在单步分支、可观测时交互引发的不确定性和对手影响等指标，来刻画环境（或游戏数据集）的迁移核。这一方法旨在为环境难度提供一组可复现的度量，帮助研究者更清晰地区分建模与强化学习任务。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Game world modeling (GWM) and reinforcement learning (RL) are often confounded because research papers rarely quantify how difficult the underlying transition prediction problem is at the declared interface (pixels/tokens/latents with finite history). We propose the Transition Complexity Profile (TCP): a small, reproducible set of metrics that characterizes an environment's (or gameplay dataset's) induced transition kernel by (i) intrinsic one-step branching, (ii) interaction-induced uncertainty and opponent influence when observable, and (iii) t…
items.why_zh: 为游戏环境难度提供统一可复现的度量，有助于更清晰地区分建模与强化学习任务。
items.why_en: It offers a reproducible way to quantify environment difficulty, helping separate game world modeling from RL challenges.

items.title_zh: 观点：行为系统需要行为测试
items.title_en: Position: Behavioral Systems Require Behavioral Tests
items.summary_zh: 该观点论文指出，人工代理系统越来越多地作为行为系统运行，与动态环境交互、追求目标并随时间适应。然而，现有评估方法主要关注性能结果，而非产生这些结果的行为过程。作者主张AI代理应像其他行为系统一样，通过系统观察、扰动和对其行为进行解释来评估。他们借鉴行为科学的经验，提出了一个相应研究议程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial agentic systems increasingly operate as behavioral systems by interacting with dynamic environments, pursuing goals, and adapting over time. Yet, current evaluation methods largely focus on performance outcomes, not the underlying behavioral processes that produce them. This paper argues that AI agents must be evaluated like other behavioral systems: through systematic observation, perturbation, and interpretation of their actions. We draw on lessons from the behavioral sciences to motivate this position, and propose a research agenda…
items.why_zh: 强调评估AI代理的行为过程而非仅看结果，对AI安全与可信非常重要。
items.why_en: It shifts AI evaluation toward behavioral processes, which is crucial for safety and trustworthiness.

items.title_zh: 观点：现有模型卡不足以支持开放权重基础模型的下游治理
items.title_en: Position: Current Model Cards Are Insufficient for Downstream Governance of Open-Weight Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 该观点论文认为，开放权重基础模型（OWFMs）的增长促使AI社区重新评估有效的下游治理策略。尽管模型卡被广泛用作模型仓库中的透明度工具，但现有框架往往无法充分告知下游开发者和用户 OWFM 带来的独特安全挑战。作者分析了Hugging Face上500个模型卡，指出有效的OWFM治理需要多层方法，整合多种互补要素。这项研究为开放权重模型的负责任发布和下游使用提供了参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18086v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The growth of open-weight foundation models (OWFMs) has prompted the AI community to re-evaluate strategies for effective downstream governance. Although model cards have been widely adopted as transparency artifacts in model repositories, existing frameworks often fail to adequately inform downstream developers and users about the distinct safety challenges posed by OWFMs. This position paper analyzes 500 model cards hosted on Hugging Face and argues that effective governance of OWFMs requires a multi-layered approach integrating three complemen…
items.why_zh: 填补开放权重模型治理空白，对AI透明度和安全监管有重要参考意义。
items.why_en: It highlights gaps in existing model documentation and proposes a roadmap for governing open-weight foundation models.

items.title_zh: 观点：多智能体系统应优先考虑并发控制
items.title_en: Position: Multi-Agent Systems Should Prioritize Concurrency Control
items.summary_zh: 该观点论文指出，基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）有望实现可扩展协作，但增加智能体往往降低可靠性。许多MAS失败本质上源于并发控制问题：智能体并发读写共享状态，且长LLM推理窗口会放大陈旧读取、丢失更新和不一致结果的风险。通常被归因于协调或通信故障的失效模式，可直接映射到经典并发异常。作者主张MAS框架应优先解决这些并发问题，以提升系统可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18092v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) promise scalable collaboration, yet adding agents often reduces reliability. This position paper argues that many MAS failures are fundamentally concurrency control problems: agents concurrently read and write shared state, and long LLM inference windows amplify the risk of stale reads, lost updates, and inconsistent outcomes. Failure modes commonly attributed to coordination or communication breakdowns can be mapped directly onto classical concurrency anomalies. We contend that MAS frameworks should address th…
items.why_zh: 这一视角将多智能体系统的可靠性问题归因于并发控制，为框架设计提供了新方向。
items.why_en: It reframes multi-agent failures as concurrency problems, pointing to more reliable framework designs.

items.title_zh: FinSkillBench：评估投资管理领域AI代理与专业技能
items.title_en: FinSkillBench: Evaluating AI Agents and Domain Skills for Investment Management
items.summary_zh: 该研究指出，投资管理是高风险的领域，代理型AI系统必须不只是生成看似合理的文本，还需检索时间点数据、组装正确的计算输入、调用专门方法，并生成可审计的结构化输出。为此，作者推出FinSkillBench评估套件，用于衡量语言模型代理能否有效使用金融领域技能解决投资管理任务。该基准涵盖三个领域：组合构建、风险管理和基本面分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Investment management is a high-stakes domain in which agentic AI systems must do more than generate plausible text. They must retrieve point-in-time data, assemble correct computational inputs, invoke specialized methods, and produce auditable structured outputs. We introduce FinSkillBench, an evaluation suite designed to measure whether language model agents can effectively use financial domain skills to solve investment management tasks. The benchmark spans three domains, portfolio construction, risk management, and fundamental analysis, and i…
items.why_zh: 首个针对投资管理的技能评估基准，有助于推动AI代理在高风险金融场景中的实用落地。
items.why_en: It provides a dedicated benchmark for assessing AI agents in high-stakes investment tasks, supporting practical adoption.

items.title_zh: 自进化智能体作为动态图变换：综述与新视角
items.title_en: Self-Evolving Agents as Dynamic Graph Transformation: A Survey and New Perspective
items.summary_zh: 该综述提出一种新视角，将基于大语言模型的智能体视为自进化系统，它们能跨互动持续存在、维护记忆、使用工具、获取技能、改进工作流并与其他智能体协调。这些能力使智能体状态具有结构性和动态性：实体、关系、属性、依赖和执行结构随新证据、反馈和环境条件而改变。作者认为，现有的图智能体综述通常将图视为支持智能体功能的结构，而非演化的基底。本文主张将自进化智能体建模为动态图变换，以更好地捕捉其演化特性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly becoming self-evolving systems that persist across interactions, maintain memories, use tools, acquire skills, refine workflows, and coordinate with other agents. These capabilities make agent states structural and dynamic: entities, relations, attributes, dependencies, and execution structures change with new evidence, feedback, and environmental conditions. Existing graph-agent surveys typically treat graphs as support structures for agent functions rather than as evolving substrates, whi…
items.why_zh: 提出动态图视角理解自进化智能体，有助于设计更适应环境变化的智能体系统。
items.why_en: It offers a new lens for modeling self-evolving agents, which may guide more adaptive agent architectures.

items.title_zh: 解决不等于画图：面向奥林匹克几何图解推理的基准
items.title_en: Solving Is Not Drawing: A Benchmark for Diagrammatic Reasoning in Olympiad Geometry
items.summary_zh: 基础模型如GPT和Claude已能熟练解决奥林匹克级别的数学问题，但“解题”与“画图”是两种不同技能。许多几何问题的解决依赖于包含正确辅助线和交点的准确图形，模型即便能推理出答案，也不一定能够生成相应图形。本文提出了面向奥林匹克几何图解推理的新基准，并与MathVista等已有基准形成对比。该工作凸显了图形生成能力与解题能力同样重要，为多模态数学推理的评估提供了新方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation models such as GPT and Claude now solve olympiad-level mathematics with remarkable proficiency, so much so that geometry problem solving has become a standard proxy for their mathematical reasoning. Yet solving a geometry problem and drawing the figure it depends on are not the same skill: progress often hinges on a faithful diagram with the right auxiliary constructions and incidences, and it is unclear that a model which reasons its way to the answer can also produce one. A growing collection of benchmarks, including MathVista, and M…
items.why_zh: 首次明确区分“解题”与“画图”，为评估AI在几何推理中的图形生成能力提供了专门基准。
items.why_en: It draws a clear distinction between solving and drawing geometry problems, introducing a dedicated benchmark for diagrammatic reasoning that existing math benchmarks overlook.

items.title_zh: 观点：AI排行榜未充分服务全球南方——以印度为例
items.title_en: Position: AI Leaderboards Are Underserving the Global South: A Case Study from India
items.summary_zh: 这篇立场论文指出，当前AI排行榜在制度设计上难以服务全球南方国家，主要因为缺乏独立的治理机制、利益冲突政策以及指标演进机制。作者认为障碍并非数据缺失，因为面向印度、非洲和阿拉伯语区域的高质量基准已经存在，如印度的IndicSUPERB、MILU和LAHAJA，非洲的IrokoBench，以及阿拉伯语的AlGhafa。问题在于全球排行榜未将这些基准纳入，也没有治理机制强制其纳入。商业压力虽可能推动部分修正，但若缺乏制度性改革，全球南方在AI发展中的代表性将持续受损。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18117v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This position paper argues that AI leaderboards are structurally ill-suited to serving the Global South because they lack independent governance, conflict-of-interest policies, and mechanisms for metric evolution. The barrier is not missing data; high-quality regional benchmarks already exist: IndicSUPERB, MILU, and LAHAJA for India; IrokoBench for Africa; AlGhafa for Arabic. The barrier is institutional design. Global leaderboards do not include these benchmarks, and no governance mechanism compels them to do so. Commercial pressure corrects lea…
items.why_zh: 揭示了AI排行榜的区域代表性缺陷，指出制度设计比数据缺失更阻碍全球南方的参与。
items.why_en: It exposes the institutional barriers that keep Global South benchmarks off global leaderboards, highlighting governance rather than data as the key issue.

items.title_zh: 优化模糊逻辑与IEEE关键气体法相结合的变压器故障诊断
items.title_en: Optimized Fuzzy Logic Approach with the IEEE Key Gas Method for Diagnosing Power Transformer Faults Using Dissolved Gas Analysis
items.summary_zh: 变压器故障诊断对保障电力系统稳定至关重要。IEEE关键气体法(KGM)是溶解气体分析(DGA)中广泛使用的方法，但在处理模糊数据和保证诊断精度方面存在不足。本研究提出一种融合模糊逻辑与IEEE KGM的增强模型(FL-KGM)，通过改进隶属函数、优化模糊规则集，并创新性地分离CO与CO2来消除诊断不一致性。利用多维度气体数据，该方法能够在复杂故障场景下提高诊断可靠性，为电力设备状态评估提供了更精确的工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable transformer fault diagnosis is essential for maintaining power system stability. The IEEE Key Gas Method (KGM), a widely utilized approach in Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA), exhibits limitations in addressing ambiguous data and ensuring high diagnostic accuracy. This study presents An enhanced model combining Fuzzy Logic with the IEEE Key Gas Method (FL-KGM) that introduces refined membership functions, optimized fuzzy rule sets, and a novel separation of CO and CO2 to eliminate diagnostic inconsistencies. By leveraging multidimensional ga…
items.why_zh: 该方法在传统IEEE关键气体法基础上引入模糊逻辑优化，显著提升了变压器故障诊断的准确性与一致性。
items.why_en: It enhances the widely used IEEE Key Gas Method with fuzzy logic, improving diagnostic accuracy and consistency for power transformer faults.

items.title_zh: FraudBench：针对自适应欺诈对银行代理进行压力测试
items.title_en: FraudBench: Stress-Testing Policy-Grounded Banking Agents Against Adaptive Fraud
items.summary_zh: 随着对话代理通过工具访问客户数据库和内部政策文档，普通客户服务与授权、欺诈检测和政策合规密不可分，银行业尤为典型：同一个回答问题的代理也可能更改联系方式、重置PIN或转账。然而，现有金融欺诈基准主要针对静态交易或消息分类，通用代理安全基准则聚焦于提示注入，无法覆盖此类动态场景。为此，论文提出FraudBench，专门对银行代理在面对自适应欺诈时的策略执行能力进行压力测试。该基准填补了银行对话代理安全评估的空白，对金融领域AI可信部署具有重要意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18136v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conversational agents now act for end users through tools while holding access to customer databases and internal policy documents that a caller can reach through dialogue alone. Banking is the clearest case: the same agent that answers a question can also change contact details, reset a PIN, or move money, so ordinary customer service is inseparable from authorization, fraud detection, and policy compliance. Existing financial-fraud benchmarks classify static transactions or messages, and general agent-safety benchmarks target prompt injection o…
items.why_zh: 填补了银行对话代理在自适应欺诈场景下安全评估的空白，对金融AI的可信部署至关重要。
items.why_en: It fills a critical gap by stress-testing banking agents against adaptive fraud, going beyond static transaction classification and prompt injection benchmarks.

items.title_zh: 低资源语言仇恨言论检测中LLM的高效适配：以罗马乌尔都语为例
items.title_en: Efficient Adaptation of LLMs for Hate Speech Detection in Low-Resource Languages: A Comparative Study on Roman Urdu
items.summary_zh: 低资源语言中的仇恨言论检测因缺乏标注数据、语言结构非正式和语法标准缺失而具有挑战性，罗马乌尔都语就是典型代表，它在南亚社交媒体上广泛使用，但拼写变体多且语境不一致。本文对多种大型语言模型在罗马乌尔都语仇恨言论检测任务上的表现进行了全面评估，并通过对这些模型进行微调来提升检测性能。研究比较了不同适配策略在低资源场景下的效率与效果，为构建面向南亚语言的AI安全工具提供了实证参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is challenging to detect hate speech in Low Resource Languages (LRLs) because of the absence of annotated data, the informality of its language structure, and the lack of standardized grammar. A good example of such a challenge is Roman Urdu which is broadly used by South Asians on social media and has a high variation while lacking contextually consistent spellings. The objective of this paper is to conduct a comprehensive assessment of Large Language Models (LLMs) for Hate Speech Detection (HSD) in Roman Urdu script and fine-tune these model…
items.why_zh: 为罗马乌尔都语等低资源语言的仇恨言论检测提供了系统的模型适配比较，有助于改善南亚社交媒体的内容安全。
items.why_en: It offers a systematic comparative study of LLM adaptation for Roman Urdu hate speech detection, advancing safety tools for low-resource South Asian languages.

items.title_zh: Redakto：LLM的隐身模式
items.title_en: Redakto - The Incognito Tab for LLMs
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型在日常生活应用中日益普及，如何确保使用过程中的隐私成为重大挑战，核心是在文本进入LLM前删除其中的个人身份信息(PII)。随着欧盟新立法的出台，这一需求变得更加紧迫。欧盟国家对LLM使用隐私的不确定性，可能会严重阻碍创新速度以及从研究到应用的转化。本文介绍Redakto，一个旨在为LLM提供隐私保护的“隐身模式”，它可以在数据送交模型前自动移除敏感信息，从而在保障隐私的同时支持合规的AI应用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are being increasingly used in everyday applications. A major challenge in the context of LLMs or Artificial Intelligence (AI) in general is to ensure privacy when using them, meaning that personally identifiable information (PII) is removed from any text that enters an LLM. These challenges have become more urgent with novel EU legislation. Uncertainty around LLM usage with respect to privacy concerns in EU countries can be a major blocker for the speed of innovation and transfer from research to applications. Here w…
items.why_zh: 为LLM使用提供了一种实用的隐私保护方案，有助于缓解欧盟法规下的合规风险并加速AI落地。
items.why_en: It provides a practical privacy solution for LLM use, reducing compliance risks under EU legislation and speeding up AI adoption.

items.title_zh: 高风险公共部门应用中开放模型的结构化信息抽取评估
items.title_en: Evaluating Structured Information Extraction with Open Models in a High Risk Public Sector Application
items.summary_zh: 从非结构化文档中提取结构化信息是各行各业数字化转型的关键环节。尽管专有方案在商业应用中占主导，但开源OCR引擎、大语言模型和视觉语言模型的快速发展提供了可及的替代方案。然而，针对现实多步骤提取流程的系统性评估仍然稀缺。本文聚焦高风险公共部门应用，系统评估了开放模型在复杂信息抽取流水线中的表现，涵盖准确性、鲁棒性与责任使用等方面，为公共部门在合规前提下选择开源AI工具提供了依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The extraction of structured information from unstructured documents represents a critical component of digital transformations in all sectors. While proprietary solutions dominate commercial applications, a rapidly growing ecosystem of open-source Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engines, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offers accessible alternatives. However, systematic evaluations on realistic, multi-step extraction pipelines remain scarce. Responsible usage of such extraction tools require comprehensive eval…
items.why_zh: 为高风险公共部门应用中的开源模型信息抽取提供了系统性评估，填补了现实多步骤流水线评测的空白。
items.why_en: It fills a gap in evaluating open models for structured extraction in high-risk public sector settings, offering insights for responsible adoption.

items.title_zh: 大规模推荐解释中LLM评判者的生命周期
items.title_en: The Lifecycle of LLM-as-a-Judge for Large-Scale Recommendation Explanations
items.summary_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge，即利用大型语言模型评估另一个AI应用或模型生成的自然语言，已成为加速和扩展人工评价的标准可扩展方法。但大多数研究将评判者视为静态工件，仅在构建时或针对固定基准进行一次评估。本文则认为，在生产系统中运行的LLM评判者应被理解为一个完整的生命周期：需要随周围数据的变化而构建、训练、部署，并持续维护。针对大规模推荐解释场景，作者探讨了评判者生命周期各阶段面临的挑战与对策，强调持续评估与动态更新对保证评判质量的重要性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18300v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge, which leverages a large language model to evaluate natural language generated by another AI application or model, has become a standard, scalable approach for accelerating and extending costly human evaluation. However, most work treats a judge as a static artifact, evaluating it once at construction or against a fixed benchmark. In contrast, we argue that an LLM judge running in a production system is better understood as having a lifecycle: it must be built, trained, deployed, and continuously maintained as the surrounding data…
items.why_zh: 将LLM评判者从静态工具重新定义为需要持续维护的生命周期，对生产系统中的推荐评估质量至关重要。
items.why_en: It reframes LLM-as-a-Judge as a lifecycle that requires continuous maintenance, which is crucial for reliable evaluation in large-scale recommendation systems.

items.title_zh: 测量部分得分差距：越南2025年凸评分制的严格基准
items.title_en: Measuring the Partial-Credit Gap: A Strict Benchmark on Vietnam's 2025 Convex Marking Scheme
items.summary_zh: 该研究指出，在人类考试中评估语言模型时，现有基准通常只按对错计分并报告整体准确率，这假设部分知识能按比例获得相应分数。然而，当考试采用非加性评分制时，这一假设并不成立，越南2025年高考改革就体现了这种替代做法的代价。考试第二部分中，考生需对每道题的四个判断题进行判断，评分方式为凸评分：正确判断的数量越多，得分越高。该研究聚焦于测量这种部分得分差距，提出了一个严格基准来评估模型在这种特殊评分规则下的表现，揭示传统准确率指标可能掩盖的问题，并为更公平的模型评估提供依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When evaluating language models on human exams, benchmarks typically score each response as right or wrong and report the overall accuracy. This approach assumes that partial knowledge is worth proportional credit, an assumption that fails when an examination uses a non-additive grading scheme. The 2025 reform of Vietnam's National High School Graduation Examination demonstrates the cost of this substitution. items.why_zh: 这项研究首次针对非加性、凸性评分规则提出严格基准，有助于更真实地衡量模型在复杂人类考试中的部分知识掌握程度。
items.why_en: It introduces a strict benchmark for non-additive convex scoring, enabling a more accurate assessment of partial knowledge in LLM exam performance.

items.title_en: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18423v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language model agents now execute bounded tasks reliably. Whether they can sustain effective decision-making over long horizons, where actions have cumulative consequences and the environment responds to their choices, remains largely unmeasured. FM-Bench (Football Management Benchmark) measures this. An LLM agent runs a football club for 20 in-game years through 26 tools and roughly 340 to 400 decision stops. items.title_en: Can a Lightweight Multimodal Model Estimate LLM Reasoning Performance? A Study for Compute-Optimal Document Inference
